title: Private Talks: Future Health Clinic Site
summary:
*   The special meeting was held as a private executive session to discuss sensitive city affairs.
*   Discussions included legal advice, potential land acquisitions, and personnel matters.
*   A key topic was acquiring lease space for a proposed North Austin Health Clinic in the northeast area.
*   No final decisions or votes were taken on any agenda items during this private session.
